title: Homology-level proper coefficient projection
statement: With the hypotheses of lem-pur-omega-proper-coefficient-projection, for every integer n the homology map induced by condensedPushScalar (omegaMap l E a) g at K is an isomorphism.

source.place: 6.8.14(1)--(2), 6.8.15; finite-stage homology comparison in compact-support realization Step 13

proof.text: Identify the finite image field of a with E, express the finite-valued closure coefficient as the filtered colimit of finite intermediate fields, and use the simultaneous coefficient-complex presentation with a common lower bound. At each finite stage the restricted coefficient module is finite free, so the proper coefficient transpose is a finite direct-sum comparison and is invertible. Bounded-below qcqs pushforward continuity and exact scalar extension identify the colimit of these finite-stage homology isomorphisms with the homology map induced by condensedPushScalar (omegaMap l E a) g.

lean.statement: theorem omegaProperCoefficientProjection_homology_isIso (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [NormedField E] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (a : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] PadicAlgCl l) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X] [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace Y] (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper g] (K : CondensedERealization.Constructible E X) : ∀ n : ℤ, IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).map ((condensedPushScalar (omegaMap l E a) g).app K.obj))
